name: BFIELD
recent: Butterfield FB Berhad 于 2026 年 9 月完成首次公开募股并在 ACE Market 上市，随后多名董事及大股东申报股权变动，包括 offer for sale 及 pink form allocation。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度的业绩。
notable: 公司完成首次公开募股并在 ACE Market 上市。
多名董事及大股东在上市后申报股权变动，包括 offer for sale 及 pink form allocation。
NationGate 董事总经理 Ooi Eng Leong 成为公司大股东。
risks: 董事 Yeap Kim Siew 及 Yeap Chin Loon 通过 offer for sale 分别出售 21,600,000 股及 50,400,000 股。
多名独立非执行董事通过 pink form allocation 获得股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度，公司录得营收 MYR 69,684,000，净利 MYR 6,470,000，净利率 9.3%。

recent_en: Butterfield FB Berhad completed its initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market in September 2026, followed by several directors and substantial shareholders declaring changes in their interests, including an offer for sale and pink form allocations. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026.
notable_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market.
Several directors and substantial shareholders declared changes in their interests after listing, including an offer for sale and pink form allocations.
NationGate managing director Ooi Eng Leong emerged as a substantial shareholder of the company.
risks_en: Directors Yeap Kim Siew and Yeap Chin Loon sold 21,600,000 shares and 50,400,000 shares respectively via an offer for sale.
Several independent non-executive directors acquired shares via pink form allocations.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 July 2026, the company recorded revenue of MYR 69,684,000, net income of MYR 6,470,000, and a net margin of 9.3%.
